date_operation_guard_findings.causal_limit: The raw per-request worker decision is not retained, so this audit proves the operation/date combination cannot be executed under the fixed contract, not that the actual private branch had an identical score or rejection reason.
date_operation_guard_findings.interpretation: The deterministic date/operation contract explains why 8 expanded offline false accepts become 6 native false accepts. The original 4/38 classifier false accepts remain unchanged.
date_operation_guard_findings.observed_native: Both direct route and full control return abstention for both rows; no error and no returned value.
date_operation_guard_findings.source_rule: Frozen contracts.validate_operation rejects a literal date for procedure; exact-tree TimeView.permits also permits literal dates only for history/change at the original exact midnight cutoff.

independent_reconstruction.authority_limit: Recomputed IDs establish byte-consistent lineage to the declared writes. Actual owner access, freshness and source-cut validation are CI execution assertions, not independently re-executed by this audit.
independent_reconstruction.direct_binding_limit: Native reports retain host direct_identity_valid and read_identity_valid but not raw worker envelopes. Request and control readout fields, values, sources and artifact digests are independently audited here; hidden direct-envelope fields cannot be re-decoded.
independent_reconstruction.independent_text_mapping_method: A separate standard-library implementation of frozen NFKC/casefold, ASCII-edge alias matching, longest non-overlapping alias binding, canonical entity checks and literal-date replacement. No encoder, model, sklearn, NumPy, ONNX or original fixture loader is imported.
source_id_method: Serialize MemoryCellAddressV1 in entity, kind, effective_at field order; stable key is memory-cell:v1: + SHA256(JSON bytes).
Derive memory:v2: and source:v1: IDs using SHA256 over u64-big-endian length-prefixed domain, owner, agent_private, empty workspace and stable-key/event suffixes.
Serialize MemoryCellRecordV1 in schema, entity, kind, effective_at, value field order; nested Value object fields follow their frozen lexicographic order.

Create head digest using hepta.cognitive.record.v1, u32-length-prefixed memory ID, revision-one u64, Fact=1, Live=0, content SHA256, no-predecessor byte=0 and exactly one explicit-memory-directive citation with its content digest.
source_id = SHA256(JSON array [hepta.sqlite.memory-cell-source.v1, scope, head digest]). Select exact required source sets per operation and timestamp.
independent_reconstruction.value_method: Use immutable original held-input records, take latest source by kind and effective_at (or greatest effective_at <= requested cutoff), then compute typed identity/add_bias/multiply/affine/clamp in Python standard-library integer arithmetic; never take fixture.expected_value or native_correct as gold.

limitations: The quality gates fail in both arms; V8 remains qualification shadow only with production admission false.
The frozen V7 one-row repeat variation is unresolved because the native reports omit internal decision scores. No inference was rerun to diagnose it.
Unique classifier OOD wordings, duplicated native requests and identity/time parser boundaries have different denominators and cannot be substituted.
The V8 historical-procedure refusal is explainable by the fixed date/operation contract; raw worker reasons were not retained, so an exact private execution-branch claim is unavailable.
The audit reconstructs complete typed values and source IDs but does not reopen the disposed SQLite owners or independently authenticate their observation time or current freshness.
The language classifier and actual semantic/procedure cell parameter training are different training stages. Native receipts contain two memory-parameter fits per arm and zero language-head fits.
Worker totals include direct probes plus full control reads. Their CPU/wall/byte counters are measured; they are not exclusive communication time or complete system lifecycle cost.
The explicit catalog and support records remain. This evidence does not establish parameter-only memory compression, cross-machine replication, population risk bounds or a general memory system.
